value.name: checks wrist number remains legible
value.description: She confirms that the number on her wrist is still readable.

value.name: presses thumb to secure marking
value.description: She presses her thumb against the skin to make sure nothing will rub off before she arrives.
evidence: she pressed the pad of her thumb against the skin to be sure none of it would lift off on the steering wheel before she got there

value.name: drives forward through changing light
value.description: As the light changes, she eases the vehicle forward.
evidence: The light changed and she eased forward

value.name: keeps folded paper steady on passenger seat
value.description: The folded paper remains flat on the passenger seat against the canvas lining where her palm had left it.
evidence: the folded form on the passenger seat still flat against the canvas lining where her palm had left it

value.name: avoids checking the time
value.description: She deliberately does not look at the time again.
evidence: She did not check the time again

value.name: focuses on arriving with paper and wrist number together
value.description: She treats the wrist number and the paper as the two things that must arrive together and limits her attention to the next block.
evidence: The number on her wrist and the paper at her side were the two things that had to arrive together
for the length of the next block that was as far ahead as she let herself look
